blocks.head: alt The cloud associates UserX with the device and UserX has no key yet
alt UserX and the device exist
alt UserY is a member of UserX and both are associated with the same device in the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : nils , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : randomStr('KeyA', N) , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ....) , .....) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (randomStr('KeyA', N)) .

eq < deviceA | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (Key) 
= < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : (cloudA , Rest) , ..) > $ UserX 'bind' deviceA | (Key) 
= < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : (cloudA , UserX , Rest) , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('trusted' : (cloudA , UserX , Rest) , 'on' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('trusted' : (cloudA , UserX , Rest) , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA .

eq < deviceA | ('trusted' : (cloudA , Rest) , 'on' : false , ..) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('trusted' : (cloudA , Rest) , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceA , ..) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : deviceA , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceA | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceA | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX, UserY) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ....) > .
